title: MITRE T1078 / T1530 Insider Threat & Unauthorized Access Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate UEBA / DLP Anomaly & Preserve Chain-of-Custody Logs
steps.description: Verify bulk repository downloads, USB mass-storage writes, or off-hours sensitive file access.

steps.activity_name: Correlate Access Against Role Need-to-Know & HR/Ticket Context
steps.description: Determine whether data access aligns with active project assignments or notice-period risk.

steps.activity_name: Scope All Touched Repositories, Personal Cloud Uploads & Endpoints
steps.description: Audit SharePoint, Git, email attachments, and removable media logs for full exposure window.

steps.activity_name: Coordinate with Legal/HR to Suspend Access & Preserve Endpoint Image
steps.description: Conditional containment executed in strict coordination with HR and Legal counsel.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Document Forensic Findings & Close Insider Investigation
steps.description: Record evidence preservation hashes and final disposition without altering raw logs.
